short_description: Adventure Paws is a pixel-style 2D side-scrolling adventure game where you and your friend will play as two cats, embarking on an exciting journey across a mysterious and unknown continent. Join the black and white cats and set off on this journey full of challenges and surprises!
steam_categories: Multi-player; Co-op; Shared/Split Screen Co-op; Shared/Split Screen; Partial Controller Support; Remote Play Together; Family Sharing
